title: MoroccoAPI: Morocco’s open data API
excerpt: Free JSON API for Moroccan geography, population, postal codes, schools, health and more. No API key. Documentation in English, French and Arabic.
content_html:
Open data. Built together.

Morocco’s open data,
ready to build with.

A community-built API that makes Moroccan public datasets easier to discover and use. One consistent JSON format, clear documentation, and a source behind every dataset.

Explore the APIContribute on GitHub

v2.3.0 · Open source

Start with geography.

Regions, provinces, and communes.
Arabic and French names included.
